versions.changelog:
- Clarified that only connector-backed libraries can be created via CLI; native libraries cannot.
- Expanded prerequisites/bootstrapping instructions with explicit install and login steps.
- Updated and streamlined descriptions and examples to distinguish between file, library, and agent attachment actions.
- Removed redundant or outdated documentation (e.g., removed skill-card.md).
- Improved triggers/examples in the skill description for clearer intent detection.

- Added skill-metadata.json for improved metadata handling.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify CLI compatibility and login instructions.
- Changed file upload examples to use --file instead of --file-path for accuracy.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation improvements and cleanup.

Initial release of the cargo-content skill.

- Introduces workspace knowledge management: upload, list, update, move, and remove files (PDFs, CSVs, text).
- Create, list, and manage libraries of files for use in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
- Adds support for native and connector-backed libraries.
- All file and library commands moved from the ai domain to the new content domain (`cargo-ai content ...`).
- Requires installation of @cargo-ai/cli and a Cargo account.
- See documentation for commands, usage examples, and troubleshooting.
